outcome_scope: The attempt tests clean Git materialization and Python standard-library isolation for the PO-03 validator suite.
limitations: The reproduction uses a fresh local Git clone on the same host; it does not prove separate-VM or network-clone behavior.
Python -S excludes site initialization and -I excludes user environment injection, but this attempt does not independently attest the operating-system Python binary.
The hidden-state fixture covers tracked, untracked, and ignored checkout entries; it does not inspect state outside the Git checkout.
This producer result is not independently accepted, parent-ingested, completed, merged, or promoted.
negative_observations: Route verification in a single-branch clone initially lacked the immutable canary result objects and failed closed; fetching the two established canary refs restored verification without changing the checkout.
The branch-creation CI run 32561391430 could not diff GitHub's all-zero push-before SHA and failed closed; every later run with a real predecessor, including the sealed result run, passed.
